paragraphs: R' Levitas of Kfar Oni. Mentioned in the Zohar, Mishpatim, 103b.[^1]

notes.text: The source gives one name form לויטס, retained as Levitas without an added alternative. איש כפר אוני gives “of Kfar Oni,” without further geographical identification. קג:. is rendered 103b under the colon convention; no Zohar edition is named or independently checked. The abbreviated title remains R'.
